veranderings.voor: Daardie tyd was die 15de en die 16de eeu.
veranderings.na: Dit was in die 15de en die 16de eeu.
veranderings.rede: Equating 'daardie tyd' with the centuries reads wooden; placing the time 'in' the centuries is the natural Afrikaans construction with the same meaning.

veranderings.blok: Wat Leonardo oor die keerpunt wys
veranderings.rede: 'die ding' has no antecedent in the block; 'dit' refers back to what he saw and measured.
